title: Spectral Extremal Graphs without a $K_k$-Factor
summary: Let $k\ge 3$ and let $n=km$. A $K_k$-factor in an $n$-vertex graph is a collection of $m$ vertex-disjoint copies of $K_k$ that covers the entire vertex set. We determine the maximum adjacency spectral radius of an $n$-vertex graph containing no $K_k$-factor when $m\ge 2k-1$. More precisely, we prove that every such graph $G$ satisfies \[ ρ(G)\le ρ(H_{n,k}), \qquad H_{n,k}=K_{k-2}\vee\bigl(K_{n-k+1}\cup K_1\bigr), \] with equality if and only if $G\cong H_{n,k}$.
